summary: Reproduced a GLM-family parser mechanism that yields empty OpenAI content when a template-opened reasoning block ends on model EOS without </think>. Verified the already-open upstream PR 37644 candidate on the prepared base instead of duplicating it. The candidate uses finish-reason evidence to distinguish a skipped-think answer from length truncation and user stop strings.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-f91eeceef600/venv/bin/python -m pytest test/registered/unit/parser/test_reasoning_parser.py::TestSkippedThinkAsContent -q (candidate tests retained; production files reverted to base)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression on the exact prepared implementation: 27 failures, 2 passes. The base lacks finish-reason plumbing and classifies an EOS-terminated unclosed GLM block as reasoning only.

Passing-after focused parser regression: 26 passed and 3 subtests passed, including EOS, length, abort, user stop string, tool-call, closed-block, streaming chunk-boundary, opt-out, and non-GLM cases.
Full focused parser and OpenAI serving regression set: 330 tests and 146 subtests passed.

Real source-checkout SGLang execution on the assigned gfx950 GPU: health became ready; /generate, OpenAI completion, batch, and streaming returned HTTP 200; streaming produced 8 SSE events; owned descendants were reaped and GPU memory returned to idle.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 recorded in /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-f91eeceef600/gpu-info.txt. The deterministic tiny-Llama server log and request/response artifacts are under /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-f91eeceef600/server-evidence; run-metadata.json records ready=true, probe_returncode=0, and process_group_alive_after_cleanup=false.

remaining_limitations: GLM-5.1 and Kimi-K2.5 weights were not present.
The reported TP8 workload requires eight GPUs, but only one gfx950 GPU was assigned.
The original LongBench V2 stochastic model behavior was therefore not reproduced end to end.
The tiny random Llama fixture validates transport and engine execution only, not GLM/Kimi architecture behavior or semantic accuracy.
The verified candidate directly addresses the GLM template/parser failure mode; it does not establish that every Kimi-K2.5 empty-output cause is fixed.
